boardLastUpdatedNote: Latest entry in the page's own Changelog ('Nov 24, 2026: Added SWE-2.1.'). data.json HTTP Last-Modified: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 23:58:54 GMT (server header, not a board statement).

scoring.score: Score is a weighted aggregate of the rubric items. Solutions that don't pass blocking criteria receive 0; runs flagged for unfair internet use receive 0 (board text). Since 2026-11-11 the cheating scanner combines rule-based checks with a filtering judge and every result was rescored.
scoring.passRate: Field 'correct': fraction of trials satisfying every blocker rubric criterion (all-or-nothing per trial), averaged over tasks.
scoring.cost: Field 'cost': mean USD spend per rollout at list API pricing, including public discounts (board label 'Cost / rollout').
scoring.flaggedRate: Fraction of runs flagged for unfair internet use (each scored 0).
scoring.headlineRanking: The default table and ld+json top-10 rank each model at its best-scoring effort; a per-effort view lists every row.

runsPerTaskNote: Not stated for the board; runsN is null on every row.
harnessLabelsNote: data.json's harness map now holds display labels ('Devin CLI', 'Codex', 'Claude Code', 'Antigravity CLI', ...); on 2026-11-01 it held raw keys ('devin-cli', 'codex', 'claude-code').
historicalLineageNote: Board JS (chunk above) lists these as lineage of the model that replaced them; they stay in data.json and are hidden from the default list. On 2026-11-01 only GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5, SWE-1.6 and SWE-1.7 were lineage; GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 now are too.
blogCrossCheck: The blog (2026-10-27) was edited in place: its results chart now lists Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Sol/Astra and Gemini 4 Neon with the same best-effort values as data.json's ld+json top 10 (checked above). Third-party mirrors were not used.
changelogSinceLastRead: Nov 12, 2026 Models Added Gemini 4 Hydrogen. Updated Gemini 4 Carbon to the Antigravity CLI harness (low, medium, and high reasoning), replacing the Devin CLI results.
Nov 11, 2026 Reporting Updated the cheating scanner to remove false positives: it now combines rule-based checks with a filtering judge. All results are rescored.
Nov 9, 2026 Models Added GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. Added Fable 5.2 and Inkling 2 Small.
Nov 5, 2026 Models Added Kimi K3.1 Pro.
Nov 4, 2026 Models Added SWE-2 Flash and Muse Spark Open.
